messages:
nina_cs: FYI Aureate flagged growing p95 and token spend on their summarization endpoint. Renewal touchpoint in 5 weeks; want a low-risk perf playbook to show value.

ash_sales: Can we quantify current cost per 1k requests and p95 baseline? Sales wants a dollar figure to use in renewal.

nina_cs: Baseline: p95 ~ 480ms, avg cost $0.012/request, monthly bill ~ $24k. Traffic: 70% summaries under 80 tokens, 20% 80-300, 10% >300. Peak window 6-8pm ET.

tara_ml: Given that distribution, two levers look promising: 1) route short summaries to a distilled/smaller model (we have model-v3-slim) and 2) aggressive prefix KV caching for repeated templates. Combined should cut token compute and latency.

leo_infra: We can deploy model-v3-slim in a dedicated pool and set a routing policy that uses intent + token-length. Example rule: if intent=="summarize" AND input_len<=80 -> route to slim pool.

aaron_customer: Concern: some of our summaries are compliance-sensitive. Will smaller model keep required legal phrasing? We need back-compat.

tara_ml: Good call. Plan: staged rollout with semantic parity checks. We'll run an offline A/B on a held-out set of 2k representative summaries measuring ROUGE/embedding-distance + a checklist for compliance phrases. Thresholds: embedding-sim >= 0.92 and zero missing mandated phrases across 2k sample.

ops-bot: Draft pilot created: aureate.slim-route-pilot. Config: 5% live traffic, prefer short inputs, fallback to model-v3-fp16. Monitors: p95 latency, token cost, rouge/delta, compliance-miss-rate. Auto-rollback triggers set: p95 > +25% OR rouge drop > 0.03 OR compliance-miss > 0.1%.

ash_sales: If we can demonstrate >=18% cost reduction with parity, we can include a committed-savings CTA in renewal pack.

nina_cs: Scheduling: propose 45-min enablement with Aureate ops to run through pilot expectations and emergency rollback. Available slots Thur 11am or Fri 2pm ET. Aaron - which works?

aaron_customer: Fri 2pm ET is best. Please include samples of what the slim model outputs for compliance templates.

leo_infra: Actionables from infra: provision dedicated slim pool (2x A100 equiv), add per-request model_tag, enable 0.5% trace sampling, and wire up KV cache metrics to the console. ETA 24h.

tara_ml: I'll run the offline parity job tonight and upload the report to the account folder. Will also add a small heuristic to detect missing legal phrases and surface examples to the team.

nina_cs: Perf metrics to capture for the renewal brief: p95 improvement, avg latency, monthlyized cost delta, sample outputs and compliance checks. Sales wants screenshots + 1-paragraph exec summary if pilot passes.

ops-bot: Pilot scheduled: route aureate.slim-route-pilot active at Fri 14:00 ET. Canary window: 72h. Alerts: configured to #incidents and notify nina_cs and tara_ml.

nina_cs: Thanks team. We'll meet Fri 2pm ET and decide on full swap vs routing mix after the 72h canary. Keep this thread for all artifacts and screenshots.

aaron_customer: Appreciated. Looking forward to seeing the safety checks in place :thumbsup:
